title: "File Attachment Failure: Existing README.md Blocks Autocomplete"
body:
**Bug Description**
I type @ to attach a file and I see a message "README.md already exists. run with -f to overwrite" and no suggestions for files to attach even when I start typing after the @ (eg @Button) 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: WarpTerminal
- Version: 1.0.6
- Feedback ID: d8a3fa9d-9681-4c81-b5d3-6238f4ce771f

**Errors**
```json
[]
```
